primary_metric: unconditional fold cl-t + signflip p; joint count/disp cl-t, per era
result_summary: ONLY the unconditional fold (fade the run, unweighted) is significant in BOTH full and recent eras on ALL 4 pairs (recent cl-t +3.2..+4.1, signflip p=0.005; ~half full-sample size). BOTH conditioners die post-2020: concentration (EUR/GBP) AND displacement magnitude (AUD/NZD) all drop to |t|<1.6. Conditioner significance is entirely pre-2020.
